positions.name: ReviewerEnrollmentRule
positions.frame: how does saving a memory enact the enrollment of its creator as a reviewer, and what is the role of the probe artifact in carrying that rule?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under the authority-ranking enactment of role assignment through stipulation rather than rank — src-1 performs the decision that saving a memory enrolls its creator as reviewer, src-2 frames the probe memory as existing solely to carry that assertion. The conviction gradient (decision-grade in src-1, claim-level in src-2) is held as tension: one performs the rule, the other subordinates the artifact to it.
